payload_contains.speaker: A Shepherd
payload_contains.text: Corusdeer. Whole herd came down off the north road. Stopped dead at the old line in the thicket. Wouldn't cross. Wouldn't spook. Turned and walked back the way they came. Something taught this herd that line. Two lambs I lost this spring. Something with thorns for teeth took them. So no. I'm not walking in there on my own.

payload_contains.speaker: A Shepherd
payload_contains.text: Here. Hoof marks come up, stop, turn, go back. Same line, every time. You can't see it from standing. Not one print past it in a mile of treeline. Teeth would've left a mess. There's no mess.
